description: W5 D1 TypeScript demo scaffolds. Pinned TypeScript version so `npx tsc` resolves this exact compiler instead of whatever npm's `latest` tag points to on the night. `type: module` matches slide 35's `--module ES2020` compile — without it, `node store-typed.js` prints a spurious MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning before the real output.
